fields.label: Applicants
fields.definition: Total first-time, first-year applicants reported in the Common Data Set.

fields.label: Admitted
fields.definition: Total first-time, first-year admitted students reported in the Common Data Set.

fields.label: Enrolled first-year students
fields.definition: Total enrolled first-time, first-year students reported in the Common Data Set.

fields.label: Acceptance rate
fields.derivation_note: Derived from the CDS applicants and admitted counts.

fields.label: Yield rate
fields.definition: Enrolled first-year students divided by admitted students.
fields.derivation_note: Derived from the CDS admitted and enrolled counts.

fields.label: SAT composite midpoint
fields.definition: Midpoint SAT composite score from the CDS testing section.

fields.label: ACT composite midpoint
fields.definition: Midpoint ACT composite score from the CDS testing section.

fields.label: SAT submit rate
fields.definition: Share of enrolled first-year students submitting SAT scores.

fields.label: ACT submit rate
fields.definition: Share of enrolled first-year students submitting ACT scores.

fields.label: Early Decision offered
fields.definition: Whether the CDS reports an Early Decision plan.

fields.label: Early Decision applicants
fields.definition: Number of Early Decision applicants reported in the CDS.

fields.label: Early Decision admitted
fields.definition: Number of Early Decision admitted students reported in the CDS.

fields.label: Early Action offered
fields.definition: Whether the CDS reports an Early Action plan.

fields.label: Wait-list offered
fields.definition: Number of applicants offered a place on the wait list.
